value.answer: Not during the day. It should be mostly cloudy and dry through the afternoon, around 23°C. Rain is likely to start after dark or overnight, and some forecasts mention a chance of thunderstorms. The forecasts don't agree on the timing or how much rain there will be, so I can't say exactly when it starts.
